verdict.rationale: Visa's REST APIs document creating a purchase-intent (POST /acp/v1/instructions) with mandate fields (amount, merchant, description) that functions like an order/cart draft, and revocation of that intent is documented as a follow-on call — but there is no explicit 'update/modify draft' endpoint, only initiate and cancel actions on the instruction/mandate object. Missing for 10: a documented update/modify-in-place endpoint for an existing cart/order object, and clearer mapping of Visa's 'instruction' concept to a literal cart/order draft rather than a payment-intent mandate.
